t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Don't worry about the time. Just make sure to select an option. Don't try to figure out a strategy, just go with your instinct.

vb_textbox.text: Just make sure to choose a gnome in time and click for the basket. Strategy doesn't seem to work; if it's a large number choose that gnome again, but that won't work indefinitely. You can look for patterns but they don't work for the whole round.Best to guess rather than run out of time. Just choose and go with it!
